name: io.github.cshum/imagor-mcp
title: imagor-mcp
description: Build and verify imagor image URLs, and render layouts at any canvas size, from an MCP client.

environmentVariables.name: IMAGOR_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: The imagor server these tools build URLs for, for example http://localhost:8000

environmentVariables.name: IMAGOR_UNSAFE
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 when the imagor server runs in unsafe mode. Leave unset when it is signed.

environmentVariables.name: IMAGOR_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: The signing secret, when the imagor server is signed. Must match the server's own secret and signer settings.

environmentVariables.name: IMAGOR_SIGNER_TYPE
environmentVariables.description: sha1, sha256 or sha512. Must match the imagor server, and defaults to sha1 as the server does.
